chapter.heading: Song of Victory over Zion’s EnemiesSong of Ascents.
chapter.v:
“Many a
time they have afflicted me from my youth,”Let Israel now say— [Ps. 99:6; Ezek. 14:14 b Ex.32:11- 14; Num. 14:13-20; Ps. 99:6 c]

“Many a
time they have afflicted me from my youth;Yet they have not prevailed against me. [Jer. 43:11; Ezek. 5:2, 12; Zech. 11:9; [Rev. 13:10] e Jer.]

The plowers
plowed on my back;They made their furrows long.” [Jer. 7:33]

The Lord
is righteous;He has cut in pieces the cords of the wicked. [Deut. 28:25 i 2 Kin. 24:3,]

Let all
those who hate ZionBe put to shame and turned back.

Let them
be as the grass on the housetops,Which withers before it grows up, [Jer. 2:13 k Is. 1:4; Jer. 7:24 l Jer. 20:16; Zech. 8:14]

With which
the reaper does not fill his hand,Nor he who binds sheaves, his arms. [Jer. 18:21; Hos. 9:12-16 n Is. 9:13; Jer. 5:3; Amos]

Neither let
those who pass by them say,“The blessing of the Lord be upon you;We bless you in the name of the Lord!” [Is. 29:5]
